VERSION.json.label_123: v1.23.0 — 'Best in Class' Phases 3+4: FTN charting groups (2022+ — QB play-action/screen/blitz rates; WR/TE contested-catch + catchable-target quality; RB screen usage) + Script Δ game-script sensitivity column; Profile (Dynasty) group on every tab (age, NFL draft capital, 40-time, Speed Score); the player drawer gains a Profile header — info chips, PlayerProfiler-style POSITIONAL PERCENTILE BARS for ~8 signature stats, and a game-script/home-road splits strip; ⚬ Scatter discovery view (usage-vs-efficiency SVG scatter of the filtered rows, any X/Y, median quadrants, click-through to the drawer); named SAVED VIEWS (☆) on the chips row.
VERSION.json.label_122: v1.22.0 — 'Best in Class' Phase 2: Routes + Next Gen Stats (2016+). New 'Receiving · Routes' group on RB/WR/TE/Flex-O — Routes run, Route% of team dropbacks, TPRR (targets per route run) and YPRR (yards per route run), the industry's headline per-route stats, from nflverse participation data. New NGS tracking groups — WR/TE: Separation, Cushion, xYAC± (YAC over expected); RB: RYOE/Att (rush yards over expected — the isolate-the-runner-from-his-line stat), Efficiency, 8+Box%; QB: Time-to-Throw, AGG% (tight-window throws). All in the Analytics preset view; mobile gets Routes/NGS sets.
VERSION.json.label_121: v1.21.0 — 'Best in Class' Phase 1: (1) Market (MFL) column group on ALL tabs — Own% / Start% / Add% / Drop% / Trade% across every MFL league + expert rank (with weekly movement) + league-scored weekly projection + MFL-wide auction value + injury status (new /api/mfl-market, 9 keyless MFL feeds, edge-cached). (2) Receiving · Air Yards group (2018+): true air yards, AY share, WOPR, RACR — SQL-only additions off data D1 already had. (3) Preset VIEW CHIPS — Standard | Advanced | Analytics | Custom, one-click per tab, saved per tab, URL-shareable. (4) L4W Δ momentum column in Consistency. (5) 🔥 MFL Movers strip (top weekly adds/drops) on the ADP sub-tab.
VERSION.json.label: v1.20.0 — Expected Points: SKILL vs LUCK. The ± now decomposes into a TD-luck bucket (TD±, ~zero year-to-year stability) and a yards+receptions skill bucket (Eff±), plus Sustain± (the reliability-weighted, sample-shrunk part projected to carry forward — calibrated on 20 seasons of split-half reliability) and Luck± (the rest, regresses). 'vs Self' measures each player against his OWN multi-year baseline (years 1-3 use a UPS draft-slot prior that ramps to their own data), 'Backed' is the independent skill support (separation / target share / ADOT / YAC / EPA / CPOE), and 'Call' is a synthesized Buy-low / Hold / Sell-high. (v1.19.1: ± tie-out fix; v1.19.0: xFP added.)
changes_120: Horizontal scrollbar moved to the TOP of the table (synced two-way); the table now scrolls in a bounded 680px region so the scrollbar + column header stay fixed while the body scrolls (works in the iframe embed, not just standalone).
Pos Rk now ranks within the IDP/offense GROUP (DL/LB/DB/QB/RB/WR/TE/PK) instead of the raw nflverse position — fixes multiple #1s showing in a single DL/LB/DB.
VERSION.json.description: The Advanced Stats Workbench gains a rank-within-position column (by MFL PPG, matching the mobile app), a coverage line that flags the 500-row cap and offseason, a 'Full profile' button in the drill-down drawer that opens the shared UPS player-profile modal, search by name/team/position, and a responsive layout for tablet/large-phone embeds. The leaderboard is also now available on the mobile site (focused per-position view).

prospect_profile.json.metric: player profile — age (as of build date), NFL draft capital (R<rd>.<pick-in-round> 'yy / UDFA 'yy; draft_pick=overall), combine forty/vert/broad/bench/cone/shuttle, Barnwell speed score (RB/WR/TE, combine weight)
prospect_profile.json.note: filtered to entry year >= 1998 (leaderboard data starts 2004)

sos-adjusted-points.definition: Sched Δ = points ÷ Opp − points, over the same final games. Opp = what the teams he faced allowed to other players at his position, against those players' usual (Pts Agst's Allowed ÷ Usual for these weeks, his own games left out); 1.10 = 10% more than usual. It describes the schedule he had; it isn't a forecast.
